purpose: Two additional phrasings per answerable fact, same expected page and expected content. One worded close to the document's own wording, one worded loosely as a user actually types. The original questions.json is left untouched so its 15 stay a pristine regression set.
why: The eval held ONE phrasing per fact, which is how a confidently wrong answer about zinc coating temperature reached a user before it reached the suite. A fact whose three phrasings disagree on the cited page is a ranking defect, and knowing which facts those are decides what is safe to ask in front of a client.

phrasings.fact: NDFT stands for nominal dry film thickness
phrasings.close: In clause 3.2 Abbreviations, what does the abbreviation NDFT mean?

phrasings.fact: relative humidity limit 85 % for blast cleaning and coating
phrasings.expected_answer: 85 % relative humidity; steel at least 3 C above dew point
phrasings.close: No final blast cleaning or coating application shall be done if the relative humidity is more than what?
phrasings.loose: how humid is too humid to paint

phrasings.fact: coating system no. 9 is 2 coats to 300 um total
phrasings.close: For coating system no. 9, what is the NDFT and the number of coats?
phrasings.loose: coating system 9 how many coats and how thick

phrasings.fact: soluble impurity limit is NaCl 20 mg/m2 per ISO 8502-9
phrasings.close: What is the maximum level of soluble impurities on the blast cleaned surface?
phrasings.loose: how much salt is allowed on the surface before painting

phrasings.fact: holiday detection voltage is given by NACE RP0188
phrasings.close: For holiday detection, which standard gives the test voltage?
phrasings.loose: what standard do i use for holiday detection

phrasings.fact: the stripe coat is applied by brush to welds, corners and edges
phrasings.expected_answer: by brush to welds, corners and edges
phrasings.close: How shall the stripe coat be applied to welds, corners and edges?
phrasings.loose: do i brush or spray the stripe coat

phrasings.fact: check frequency before each shift and twice per shift, RH limit 85 %
phrasings.expected_answer: before start of each shift and at least twice per shift; relative humidity limit 85 %
phrasings.close: What is the check frequency for ambient and steel temperature, relative humidity and dew point, and what is the relative humidity limit?
phrasings.loose: how often do i check humidity and what's the max

phrasings.fact: coating system no. 1 is minimum 3 coats to 280 um MDFT
phrasings.close: For coating system no. 1, what is the minimum number of coats and the MDFT of the complete coating system?

phrasings.fact: maximum operating temperature for zinc metal coating is 120 C
phrasings.close: What is the maximum operating temperature when zinc or alloys of zinc metal coating is used?
phrasings.loose: max operating temp for zinc coating

phrasings.fact: roughly 95 % of crashes are caused by human error
phrasings.close: What percentage of automobile crashes is caused by human error?
phrasings.loose: how many accidents are human error
